name: Redemption
source: You play as Herman, an ordinary retail store clerk whose mundane life is suddenly turned upside down after a chance encounter with a mysterious girl at a nightclub. One impulsive decision leads him down a path he could never have imagined: drifting helplessly through time, jumping uncontrollably between different eras, moments, and versions of his own life.
translation: 你扮演赫尔曼，一名普通的零售店店员，在夜总会偶遇一位神秘女孩后，他的平凡生活突然发生了翻天覆地的变化。一个冲动的决定让他走上了一条他从未想象过的道路：无助地在时间中漂流，不受控制地在不同的时代、时刻和自己的生活版本之间跳跃。
